# Hiring People in Organizations: The State and Future of the Science

<!-- generated by scripts/generate_topic_pages.py -->

← Back to topic

**Authors:** Paul R. Sackett, Filip Lievens, Richard N. Landers  
**Year:** 2026  
**Journal:** Annual Review of Organizational Psychology and Organizational Behavior  
**DOI:** [10.1146/annurev-orgpsych-020924-072127](https://doi.org/10.1146/annurev-orgpsych-020924-072127)

**Keywords:** hiring, personnel selection, recruitment, organizational psychology, science of selection, future directions

## Abstract

A comprehensive review of the science of hiring in organizations, covering the current state of personnel selection research including emerging technologies like AI, gamification, and social media assessments, and charting future research directions.
